approval_statement: These have all be verified by me and approved to proceed with
separate_migration_note: Audit existing closed-v1 words breakthrough, sunshine and weekend for carry-forward into v2; they are not in this 14-row review.
scope_guard: Content approval only. This is not Teaching Dictionary import authority, Compound v2 publication authority, route release, Model C activation, learner activation, or Production learner-data mutation.

final_component_meanings: furniture that you sleep in
a space inside a building
rows.final_relationship: A bedroom is a room with a bed, used for sleeping.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: Mother took the baby to the bedroom.
rows.review_notes: Existing governed facts are coherent; approve the proposed semantic relationship.

final_component_meanings: the part at the end of your leg
a round object used in games
rows.final_whole_meaning: a game where players kick a ball into goals
rows.final_relationship: Football is a game played with a ball mainly using the feet.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: Children play football in the playground.
rows.review_notes: Existing governed facts are coherent; approve the proposed semantic relationship.

final_component_meanings: in family words, one generation further away than a parent or child
a female parent
rows.final_whole_meaning: the mother of one of your parents
rows.final_relationship: A grandmother is the mother of one of your parents; grand shows that she is one generation further back in the family.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: Mia wrote a letter to her grandmother.
rows.review_notes: Resolve the ambiguity in favour of the family-generation sense of grand. Do not use the ordinary 'impressive/important' adjective sense.

final_component_meanings: the place where you live
a job or task that needs effort
rows.final_whole_meaning: school work that a teacher asks a pupil to do at home
rows.final_relationship: Homework is work, meaning tasks to complete, that a pupil does at home.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: I finished my homework before tea.
rows.review_notes: Correct work from the verb sense ('to do a job') to the noun sense needed by the compound.

final_component_meanings: to have fun with games or toys
the surface under your feet
rows.final_whole_meaning: an outdoor place where children play
rows.final_relationship: A playground is ground set aside for children to play on.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: The children played in the playground.
rows.review_notes: Existing governed facts are coherent; approve the proposed semantic relationship.

final_component_meanings: water that falls from clouds
a curved shape
rows.final_whole_meaning: a curved band of colours seen in the sky after rain
rows.final_relationship: A rainbow is a bow-shaped curve of colours that can appear when sunlight shines through drops of rain.
rows.review_notes: Refine the relationship for scientific/semantic accuracy while keeping the child-facing link to rain + bow.

final_component_meanings: the star that gives Earth light and heat
the part of a plant that is often brightly coloured and makes seeds
rows.final_whole_meaning: a tall plant with a large yellow flower head
rows.final_relationship: A sunflower is a flower with a large round yellow head that looks like the sun.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: The sunflower grew beside the fence.
rows.review_notes: Approve canonical whole-word creation, meanings, relationship, dictation and assignment eligibility.

final_component_meanings: water that has frozen solid
the thick, rich part of milk
rows.final_whole_meaning: a sweet frozen food made mainly from milk or cream
rows.final_relationship: Ice cream is a sweet frozen food; ice tells us that it is frozen, and cream points to the milk or cream used to make it.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: We had ice cream after the park.
rows.review_notes: Approve cream canonical creation. Treat the relationship as explanatory rather than a strict literal sum.

final_component_meanings: spending everyday life in a home
a space inside a building
rows.final_whole_meaning: a room in a home where people sit and spend time together
rows.final_relationship: A living room is a room used for everyday living, such as sitting, talking and relaxing together.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: We read together in the living room.
rows.review_notes: Use the compound-specific sense of living rather than the broad abstract definition 'the way people live'.

final_component_meanings: a female parent
part of the fixed expression in-law
part of the fixed expression in-law, which means related through marriage
rows.final_whole_meaning: the mother of a person's husband or wife
rows.final_relationship: A mother-in-law is a mother connected to someone through marriage; in-law is a fixed expression that shows that family relationship.
rows.review_notes: Resolve the ambiguity by treating in-law as a fixed non-literal family expression. Keep mother | in | law structurally for spelling, but do not teach ordinary meanings of in + law as the semantic sum. Canonical in/law rows may retain ordinary dictionary meanings; the compound structure should pin these compound-specific senses.

final_component_meanings: some, but not all, of something
the hours spent doing an activity
rows.final_whole_meaning: for fewer hours than a full-time job or course
rows.final_relationship: Part-time work or study takes only part of the usual working time.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: Dad works part-time at the library.
rows.review_notes: Approve canonical whole/component creation, meanings, relationship, dictation and assignment eligibility.

final_component_meanings: letters and parcels that are sent and delivered
a room or place where people do work
rows.final_whole_meaning: a place where letters and parcels are sent and collected
rows.final_relationship: A post office is an office where people send and collect post.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: We bought stamps at the post office.
rows.review_notes: Approve post office and office canonical creation, the noun sense of post, meanings, relationship, dictation and assignment eligibility.

final_component_meanings: the number 20
the number 1
rows.final_whole_meaning: twenty and one more: the number 21
rows.final_relationship: Twenty-one combines twenty and one to make the number 21.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: There are twenty-one children in our class.
rows.review_notes: Approve twenty canonical creation, its numeric meaning, relationship and assignment eligibility; retain governed whole/dictation/span facts.

final_component_meanings: to a high degree; very
recognised or familiar to people
rows.final_relationship: Something well-known is known by many people; well strengthens the meaning of known.
rows.final_dictation_sentence: The castle is a well-known landmark.
rows.review_notes: Use the adverb sense of well ('to a high degree; very') and avoid implying that the phrase is simply 'known well enough'.
